useGlint.title: Use default glint
useGlint.description: If false, removes the default glint texture from every item.

cap.title: Layer cap
cap.description: Controls the maximum allowed CIT enchantment layers per item.

method.title: Method
method.description: Determines how visibility is controlled for CIT enchantments.

fade.title: Fade
fade.description: Controls how long CIT enchantments fade when method is cycle.
